{"caption":"Schematic comparison of four ways to retain, extend, or revise an agent’s interaction history across successive timelines.","description":"The figure has four labeled panels. In all panels, gray rounded boxes denote Task tokens, orange boxes denote LLM-generated action or thought-plus-action tokens, blue boxes denote observations or other environment/masked tokens, and purple boxes denote memory tokens. Black arrows show downward sequence order unless otherwise noted.

Basic Causal Template: One TSR Timeline #1 is laid out in two vertical portions: Task → action 1 → obs 1 → …, and … → action t → obs t. The ellipses indicate omitted intervening tokens.

Reasoning-Augmented Template: Three timelines show progressively longer histories. TSR Timeline #1 is Task → <think> + action 1. Timeline #2 is Task → action 1 → obs 1 → <think> + action 2. Timeline #3 is Task → action 1 → obs 1 → action 2 → obs 2 → <think> + action 3.

Sliding Context Window Template: Three green-outlined timelines show successive windows. Timeline #n is Task → action 1 → obs 1 → action 2 → obs 2 → … → action t → obs t. Timeline #(n+1) is Task → purple mem M₁,ₜ → a small blue … ×Echo block → action t+1 → obs t+1 → … → action 2t → obs 2t. Timeline #(n+2) is Task → purple mem M₁,₂ₜ → a small blue … ×Echo block → action 2t+1 → obs 2t+1 → … → action 3t → obs 3t. Purple connectors route completed timelines through purple Memory Extract nodes below the first and second windows, then forward to the memory token in the next window. The legend identifies orange as LLM Generated Action Tokens (Compute Policy Loss), blue as Environment Tokens / Masked Action Tokens, gray as Task Tokens, and purple as Memory Tokens.

Self-context Managing Template: Four columns show TSR Timelines #n, #n*, #(n+1), and #(n+2). Timeline #n is Task → action 1 → obs 1 → action 2 → obs 2 → <think> + action 3. Timeline #n* is Task → action 1 → obs 1 → action 2 → obs 2 → action 3; beneath it, a Context Operation Command Prompt points downward to a Context Operation block. Between #n* and #(n+1), green right-pointing arrows labeled Operation: Preserve carry action 1, action 2, and action 3 forward. A red right-pointing arrow labeled Operation: Discard maps obs 1 to a (discarded) block. A purple right-pointing arrow labeled Operation: Compress maps obs 2 to obs 2′. Timeline #(n+1) then continues Task → action 1 → (discarded) → action 2 → obs 2′ → action 3 → obs 3 → <think> + action 4. Timeline #(n+2) shows Task → action 1 → (discarded) → action 2 → obs 2′ → action 3 → obs 3 → action 4 → obs 4 → <think> + action 5. The arrows within each timeline point downward between successive boxes.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
